stimulus.const: Run identity.scim.service-provider-config then identity.scim.schemas-list then identity.scim.schema-get then identity.scim.resource-types-list then identity.scim.resource-type-get then identity.scim.search then identity.scim.user-list then identity.scim.user-search then identity.scim.user-create then identity.scim.user-get then identity.scim.user-replace then identity.scim.user-patch then identity.scim.user-delete then identity.scim.group-list then identity.scim.group-search then identity.scim.group-create then identity.scim.group-get then identity.scim.group-replace then identity.scim.group-patch then identity.scim.group-delete then identity.scim.bulk for success, failure, denial cases using schemas, search_request, attributes, excluded_attributes, filter, start_index, count, sort_by, sort_order, writable_user, writable_group, external_id, bulk_operations, fail_on_errors and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: every advertised discovery, User, Group, GET list, POST search, replace, PATCH, delete, and Bulk operation matches pinned RFC fixtures; collections use exact ListResponse envelopes; writable inputs reject id and meta; externalId remains non-unique; scimType is omitted without a registered exact condition; Bulk results include method and conditional bulkId; failOnErrors rejects values above 100; ETag, filter, sort, projection, and pagination claims are exact; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden; required artifact fields: conformance_case_count, passed_case_count, advertised_operation_count, covered_operation_count, schema_digest, search_response_digest, filter_result_digest, sort_result_digest, etag_digest, bulk_response_digest, protocol_case_results, wire_contract_cases
